ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 85% high-intensity (white) interior pixels and 15% low-intensity (black) peripheral and focal pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white zone across the interior of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and terminal tips. Three distinct circular black spots are visible: two on the mid-section of the left lobe and one on the mid-section of the right lobe. Concentrated black mottling is situated at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression exhibiting an obtuse angle of approximately 115-120 degrees at the vertical midline vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged irregularity and high-amplitude peaks are localized at the distal terminal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature sweeping from the central notch upward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Three primary dark, roughly circular pixel clusters: two on the left lobe (one medial, one lateral) and one on the right lobe (medial position).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, short, dark, vertically-oriented linear disruption is detected in the upper quadrant of the right lobe's white interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy, textured, high-contrast clusters (calcified growths) are present at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Irregular dark tissue clustering is visible at the junction of the peduncle and the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, low-intensity dark specks are visible along the lower white boundary adjacent to the trailing edge of the left lobe.
